rationale: The original thesis remains intact as PRMB continues to consolidate near the upper end of its daily range (83.0%) on drying 1-minute volume, suggesting supply is diminishing rather than sellers overpowering buyers. The 5-minute 9-EMA has constructively risen from $22.61 at entry to $22.70, providing rising dynamic support below the current price of $22.75. With price holding well above both Session VWAP ($22.53) and the $22.58 invalidation level, the reward-to-risk profile to test the $23.00 high remains favorable.
